briefings.title: VP JD Vance in NC and what it means for NC-01

people.name: Dawn Vaughan
people.role: Host and Capitol Bureau Chief, The News & Observer

briefings.tldr: Vice President J.D. Vance’s visit to Rocky Mount underscores North Carolina's 1st Congressional District (NC-01) as a critical 2026 battleground, as the GOP attempts to flip the seat by labeling Democratic incumbent Don Davis a partisan loyalist despite his moderate voting record.
